findings.msg: the page has no visible h1
findings.fix: put the category noun in the h1 (and who it is for, or where), in 2 to 8 words

findings.msg: the first screen holds no number, price, date, place, platform or genre
findings.fix: put one hard fact from the brief on the first screen: a number, a price, a date, the place, the platforms it runs on or a game's genre; take it from the brief or remove the claim

findings.msg: <html> has no lang: a screen reader guesses the language and hyphenation is off
findings.fix: set <html lang> to the language the page is written in, from the brief ("de" for a German page)

findings.msg: the page has no visible h1
findings.fix: size headings by level: the h1 largest, one size per level, each level below the one above

findings.msg: no <meta name="description">: a search result and a shared link show a scrap of the page instead
findings.fix: write a <title> "Name: what it is for whom or where" and a one-sentence description in other words (starter.html)

findings.msg: the head lacks og:description, theme-color: a shared link shows no picture or title of its own
findings.fix: copy the head block of starter.html: og tags, twitter:card, the icon and theme-color (references/system.md, Head)

findings.msg: no sections found: nothing in <main>, or at the top of the page, to measure (SR-1)
findings.fix: make the hero exactly one screen (height: 100svh) with its content between the nav and 24px above the fold

findings.msg: no sections found: nothing in <main>, or at the top of the page, to measure (SR-2)
findings.fix: set every section after the hero to one screen or two (height: calc(var(--h,1) * 100vh)) and fit its content above --padb

findings.msg: no sections found: nothing in <main>, or at the top of the page, to measure (SR-3)
findings.fix: keep 128-480px of air between sections (--padt, --padb), fill each section to 55% or merge it into the one above, and drop divider rules

findings.msg: no sections found: nothing in <main>, or at the top of the page, to measure (SR-4)
findings.fix: make each section exactly one or two screens so a screen shows one section; every block of <main> a <section>, no bands inside one

findings.msg: no sections found: nothing in <main>, or at the top of the page, to measure (SR-5)
findings.fix: give each section one h2, first in its .wrap, and the hero only its h1, so headings sit a screen apart

findings.msg: no sections found: nothing in <main>, or at the top of the page, to measure (SR-6)
findings.fix: put everything on one .wrap: the same margin left and right (64-120px, 16-24px on a phone), text on its left line or the one split line

findings.msg: no sections found: nothing in <main>, or at the top of the page, to measure (SR-7)
findings.fix: start a row's first item on the container's left line and end its last on the right line, all one height, nothing scrolling sideways

findings.msg: no sections found: nothing in <main>, or at the top of the page, to measure (SR-8)
findings.fix: top-align every split, text left and visual right, the right column on one shared line, edge to edge on the container

findings.msg: partly measured: the effect files and the WebGL and mount counts (HTTP 404)
findings.fix: run the check again on a quieter machine; if it keeps failing, the probe error line says what stopped it
